CREATE TABLE `payment_orders` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `order_number` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `external_order_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `product_code` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `product_label` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `billing_period_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `billing_period_label` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `order_amount` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL,
  `legacy_amount_confirmed` decimal(20,8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `referral_credit_applied` decimal(20,8) NOT NULL,
  `currency_code` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `status_label` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `payment_method_code` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at_utc` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `paid_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `revision` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `origin` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `legacy_order_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `migration_run_id` char(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_sha256` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `imported_at_utc` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_order_number` (`order_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_order_owner` (`id`,`user_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_order_external` (`external_order_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_order_legacy` (`legacy_order_id`),
  KEY `idx_payment_order_user_created` (`user_id`,`created_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_payment_order_status_created` (`status`,`created_at_utc`,`id`),
  KEY `fk_payment_order_migration` (`migration_run_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_order_migration` FOREIGN KEY (`migration_run_id`) REFERENCES `data_migration_runs` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_order_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_amount` CHECK (((`order_amount` >= 0) and (`referral_credit_applied` >= 0) and (`referral_credit_applied` <= `order_amount`) and ((`legacy_amount_confirmed` is null) or (`legacy_amount_confirmed` >= 0)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_origin` CHECK ((((`origin` = _utf8mb4'legacy_import') and (`legacy_order_id` is not null) and (`legacy_order_id` > 0) and (`migration_run_id` is not null) and (`source_sha256` is not null) and (`imported_at_utc` is not null) and (`legacy_amount_confirmed` is not null)) or ((`origin` = _utf8mb4'native') and (`legacy_order_id` is null) and (`migration_run_id` is null) and (`source_sha256` is null) and (`imported_at_utc` is null) and (`legacy_amount_confirmed` is null)))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_paid_time` CHECK (((`status` <> _utf8mb4'paid') or (`paid_at_utc` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_payment_order_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'paid',_utf8mb4'cancelled',_utf8mb4'expired')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
